text.tspan: Slow. This permanent is a Generator attuned to the
Circuit: during the Generation Phase, it produces 1
Circuit Point, added to its controller's Circuit resource
pool. Spent: if you have taken an Assault action this turn
that resulted in a Capture (Section 8.6, which defines
Assault and Capture), create an exact token copy of this
permanent, put directly onto the Field under your control.
The Wrought Assembly, Technology as inevitability: the instant a
Capture lands, the design that took the Planet is already
